notes.title: Cease To Breathe v1.2.13 Changelog (The Ugly Patch)
notes.notes:
Cease To Breathe v1.2.13 Changelog (The Ugly Patch)

Today's update fixes a slew of issues, but, most importantly, it also breaks any saved game prior to the new version. I had to make some major changes to the engine and due to how I handled saved games, this led to a complete instability between the two. Therefore, you're all going to have to start over. I know, I can feel it. You hate me. I am sorry. Moving forward, this should never have to happen again. Also included in today's patch:

- Fixed an issue with the basement door not opening/closing correctly
- Fixed an issue pertaining to the 'Mongrel Death'
- Fixed an issue with objects not properly resetting (The BIG update that broke saved games)
- Fixed a slew of typos and some smaller bugs here and there (of which I forget at this particular moment lol)

Speaking of typos, I realize there have been a handful (or more) of them found by all of you, my dear players, and I am working diligently to fix the rest of these in another, future patch! (It takes a while to comb through the code and find them all. I wish there was an easy way to just spellcheck the entire thing, but I haven't found a way through Construct's interface to do so. I could probably comb the individual JS files though, and I may do this if trying to edit everything through the GUI Interface proves too much of a chore...)

Thank you to everyone, especially the Indieverse Community, for your support and the love you all have shown!

Until next time, stay toasty my friends!

- Sam

notes.title: The Road To Release!
notes.notes:
Well Met Internet Travelers!

I've been incredibly busy getting the game done and wanted to share the current state of Cease to Breathe with everyone. As of right now:

Cease to Breathe has risen to well over 500 fully interactive objects now, across 20 different rooms.
Almost all sounds have been recorded and implemented into the game! I have a few more samples I'd like to get in there but, overall, I'm quite happy with the outcome.
Scene polishing, for the most part is done, and any more graphical modifications will only occur if I have some extra time between now and release.
Musical tracks are underway and I launched the first official trailer yesterday! If you haven't seen it yet, give it a view - I think it turned out pretty cool.


Speaking of the release, we have an official date now of July 3rd, 2023! It's a short amount of time to finish up the remaining tasks that need to be completed, but I'll get 'er done! Those tasks include:

More end-game content! I am actually working on completing this tonight/tomorrow and, since it doesn't require any graphical elements and only code, it shouldn't take very long.
The rest of the musical tracks and sound samples (see above).
More talk interactions. Originally I had planned on a full dictionary of possible responses, but the scale of such an undertaking will undoubtedly force me to reduce this feature to select key phrases and responses, with a little bit of randomness intersparsed throughout.
BUGTESTING!


Most important of all, there will be no Early Access! Since this is an adventure game, I feel it would be ruined if I put out a incomplete product. I am intending to have the game 100% complete, so, aside from the sporadic bug someone out there will undoubtedly find (lol), you will be purchasing a completely finished game here. Besides bug fixes, there will be no additional content as I have some ideas already about my next project. Whether there is a Cease to Breathe 2 down the road is still up in the air. I guess it depends on how much you all like this one!

As always, an enormous THANK YOU to every single person who has wishlisted the game. This means more to me than you will ever know. The next time you hear from me it will be RELEASE TIME!!!  

LET'S GO!!

Until then, get out there and have some fun people! You all deserve it!

- Sam

notes.title: The Road To Release!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow awesome people!

It's been some time since I last left an update so here we go!

 The Storyline is finished! We have a beginning, we have an ending, and we have a nice juicy middle to enjoy here! Think of this as fully loaded burger (or vegan burger), with all the trimmings.
 A grand total of 484 interactive objects (so far) across 22 rooms!
 A multitude of working systems that can be used (or disused) across all objects. While I'm not at liberty to say what these systems are (for fear of letting all my cats out of all my bags), I will tell you that they both make sense, in the context of the game world, and they are also crucial to solving some of the puzzles and problems you will encounter along the way.
 Alternate methods of solving problems and NO DUMB DEATHS! The only time you should die in one of my games is by making a stupid decision. Don't do that and you should be good to go!
 LOTS of chances to make stupid decisions!
 The Main Menu has been completed, along with a working save/load system. No save slots, save anywhere, anytime! The way us Retro Gamers like it!

So what's left, you may ask? Well, I'll tell you!

 Completing the End-Game mechanics and the final scenes that go along with it.
 Designing two dream sequence screens to go along with key plot points in the game.
 The completion of all object interactions and responses and all Room descriptions. So far, I'd put this somewhere in the high 60%'s as completed.
 General polishing. There are some scenes I'd like to add more 'fluff' too, and maybe a few more objects, so once the bulk above is complete, I'll be concentrating a few days on this area.
 Sound & Music! This shouldn't take an overt amount of time since since I've been a musician most of my life, but it's on the To Do list nonetheless!
 Testing!  I'll be forcing my son to test the game and not paying him a dime.
 Finalizing marketing material, and release!

I am REALLY excited to share this game with you all and I thank everyone for the continued wishlist additions!  That's why I'm predicting a potential release date of around late May/Early June! Fingers crossed!

Hugs and Kisses, 

Your Most Humble Bard,

Sam

notes.title: The Road To Release!
notes.notes:
Well met, travelers!


Currently, as of this very day, Cease To Breathe is around 70% complete and features the following:

[olist]
20 Locations (A nice, sprawling, openworld-esque house to explore!)
440 Interactive Objects!
An ambient storm & weather system that 'gets worse as you go'
A coherant plot/mystery with several branching paths. Gameplay choices WILL affect the ending you get!
[/olist]

This game is truly a labor of love for me. I've played some of the best (and worst) adventure games, from the late 80's up until now, and using that, I've attempted to capture all the things I've loved about those games. At the same time, I've actively tried to avoid the things that peeved us off! In this game, you will find no needless mazes, no brute force puzzles, and no illogical BS. There are no unneccesary time limits and each and every object can be interacted with.

I will continue to post new screenshots, and a video soon, as they come and I'm expecting to release this summer. Which reminds me, a huge THANK YOU to all who have wishlisted! I can't wait to share this with you all. To quote Indy, "I'm as giddy as a schoolboy!".

Much love,

Sam
